purpose: Adjudicate a stable current quantum-hardware form for the frozen Stage75 variable-k receptor-selection CQM by measuring direct CQM-to-BQM penalty precision, ideal Zephyr embedding overhead, and a feasibility-preserving fixed-k swap-BQM reverse-annealing route under quantization and coefficient-noise proxies.

direct_cqm_to_bqm.penalty_rule: Use ten times the largest absolute frozen objective coefficient, matching the documented default scale while making the multiplier explicit.
direct_cqm_to_bqm.purpose: Measure logical-size, density, auxiliary-variable, ideal-embedding, and coefficient-resolution costs. This route must pass both embedding and precision gates before direct QPU use.

local_swap_bqm.move_rule: A binary move removes one selected receptor and adds one unselected receptor. Retain only moves whose integer quality-deficit delta is nonpositive, so every single move preserves cardinality and cannot worsen the frozen quality constraint.
local_swap_bqm.candidate_order: Sort by true frozen objective delta, then deficit delta, removed index, and added index; keep the first 40.
local_swap_bqm.objective_rule: Linear terms are exact single-move energy deltas. Nonconflicting quadratic terms are exact second-order objective corrections. Conflicting moves receive a positive exclusion interaction.
local_swap_bqm.outer_variable_k_rule: Refine every frozen fixed-k frontier independently and compare the returned guarded candidates classically across k. The QPU subproblem remains fixed-k, while the scientific model remains variable-k.
local_swap_bqm.warm_guard: Always retain the classical warm state, reject conflicting or quality-infeasible reads, and accept a hardware candidate only after recomputing the frozen true objective.

hardware_proxy.noise_interpretation: Gaussian coefficient perturbations are deterministic stress-test proxies measured as fractions of normalized full scale; they are not calibration models for any physical QPU.

warm_start_emulation.method: classical nonmonotonic-temperature proxy initialized at the all-zero swap state; it tests encoding stability and is not a quantum simulation

benchmark_gate.interpretation: Passing the local route authorizes only a budget request for a small matched-control reverse-annealing PoC. It does not authorize a cloud job, QPU job, scaling claim, or quantum-advantage claim.

hardware_route_review.reason: Accepts the frozen constrained model directly and avoids manual penalty precision, but is explicitly quantum-classical hybrid and cannot isolate a pure-QPU contribution.
Matches the Stage76 frontier-warm mechanism and the Stage77 feasibility-preserving 40-variable swap BQMs; requires physical embedding and schedule calibration.

hardware_route_review.native_interface: gate-model cost Hamiltonian and custom mixer
hardware_route_review.reason: Warm-start QAOA is maintained and Heron has enough nominal qubits, but the full dense interaction graph creates substantial two-qubit routing depth.
Connectivity is favorable for a reduced local QAOA, but 56 qubits cannot hold the largest 117-variable direct BQM and no target-specific advantage evidence exists.
The 36-qubit count is below the frozen 40-variable local cap and far below the full model.
Aquila has 256 atoms, but the current arbitrary signed dense BQM is not a native unit-disk MIS; generic transformations can add substantial overhead and alter the experimental question.

interpretation_boundary: Stage77 uses consumed historical development targets and ideal Zephyr topology to test representation, deterministic warm-start emulation, coefficient quantization, and synthetic coefficient-noise robustness. It does not use a physical working graph, device calibration, chain-break data, cloud solver, QPU, new docking, fresh validation, or locked test data. A passing local gate supports only a small budget-capped reverse-annealing PoC with matched classical controls, not a quantum scaling or advantage claim.
